provenance.change: Portable SIMD existence mask returned as usize (0 or1), caller tests !=0. Main memchr/find/split untouched; original16B cutoff reused, vector16 overlapping tail.
acceptance: no reproducible regression in tested scenarios
provenance.endianness_and_pointer_guard: unsigned byte SliceContains: aarch64 + neon + little endian +64bit; helper aarch64+neon+64bit
provenance.audit_method: read-only Python ELF parser; no objcopy rewriting of measured artifacts
provenance.tail_change: original word and scalar hit/tail paths; SIMD restricted to long body
